articles.summary: Understanding waste is the first step toward reducing it. Casella recently partnered with UMass Chan Medical School to conduct a hands-on waste audit, sorting and measuring material streams to uncover opportunities for greater recycling and waste diversion. The findings will help inform future educational efforts, enhance recycling accessibility, and support data-driven decisions that advance the campus’s sustainability goals.
articles.title: Measuring What Matters: Inside a Waste Audit

articles.summary: As a Territory Sales Representative serving customers across New Hampshire and Vermont, Tyler Hagan is focused on building relationships that go beyond day-to-day service. By taking the time to understand each customer’s unique goals and challenges, Tyler helps connect businesses and organizations with solutions that support their operational and sustainability objectives.
articles.title: Built on Trust: Territory Sales Representative Tyler Hagan
